references.text: People seek God and wish to know his ways, but their actions are not in line with his will, like those who claim to have prophesied and performed miracles in Jesus' name, yet do not live according to God's will.
Warns against false prophets who lead people astray, paralleling those who claim to have prophesied in Jesus' name without following God's will.
False messiahs and false prophets will perform great signs and wonders to deceive, like those who perform miracles in Jesus' name but do not know him.
People claim to have a relationship with Jesus based on their deeds, but Jesus rejects them because he does not know them, paralleling those who act in Jesus' name without genuine faith.
Unauthorized persons attempt to cast out demons by invoking Jesus' name, illustrating the dangers of acting in Jesus' name without a true connection to him.
Paul speaks of having prophetic gifts and being able to perform miracles, but without love these actions are worthless, like claiming to do miracles in Jesus' name without genuine faith and love.
